# AI-XF 0.5 reference validator

`ai-xf-validate.py` is copied unchanged from [`tools/ai-xf-validate.py`](https://github.com/DavidROliverBA/ai-xf-format/blob/dfe610905a63c157924ad25b2c2a908749dac7ad/tools/ai-xf-validate.py) at tag `v0.5` (commit `dfe6109`), under its [MIT licence](LICENSE).

Don't edit it: to support a new AI-XF version, copy that version's validator into a new `ai-xf-<version>/` folder next to this one.
